prompt: Today I have very (little / few) marking, so we can visit the cinema.
explanation_ru: Marking (проверка работ) — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому в значении «мало» используется little, а не few.

prompt: Nearly all of the grant money (was / were) spent on fixing the leaking roof above the sports hall.
explanation_ru: Слово money неисчисляемое, поэтому конструкция all of the grant money согласуется с глаголом в единственном числе — was.

prompt: We visited (several / much) quiet fishing villages along the coast near Plymouth.
explanation_ru: Villages — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому подходит several («несколько»), а не much.

prompt: According to our manager, a number of billing errors still needs to be sorted out before the audit starts.
answer: According to our manager, a number of billing errors still need to be sorted out before the audit starts.
accepted_answers: According to our manager, a number of billing errors still need to be sorted out before the audit starts.
explanation_ru: Конструкция a number of («несколько, ряд») с существительным во множественном числе всегда требует глагола во множественном числе — need. Частая ошибка — путать её с the number of.

prompt: Luckily, most of the guests at the hall (was / were) polite and calm.
explanation_ru: После most of число глагола зависит от существительного: guests стоит во множественном числе, значит нужно were.

prompt: Local police have not released ___ official information about the train delay near Coventry yet.
explanation_ru: В отрицательном предложении с неисчисляемым information употребляется any. Частые ошибки — ставить some в отрицании или many/a few перед неисчисляемым.

prompt: Ewan arrived at the conference hall two hours before the opening talk. A lot of furniture still (has / have) to be moved into the side rooms before the speakers get here. Meanwhile, I am printing a fresh (sheet / paper) for each welcome folder at reception. Once the chairs are lined up, we can finally make some tea.
explanation_ru: Furniture — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому после a lot of furniture нужен глагол в единственном числе (has). Отдельный лист бумаги обозначается конструкцией a sheet of paper.

prompt: Surprisingly, the (number / amount) of teenagers joining the weekend chess club is twice as high as in winter.
explanation_ru: Для исчисляемого существительного teenagers («количество подростков») используется the number of, а не amount.

prompt: Thankfully, there are far less delivery vans on our narrow lane than on the ring road.
answer: Thankfully, there are far fewer delivery vans on our narrow lane than on the ring road.
accepted_answers: Thankfully, there are far fewer delivery vans on our narrow lane than on the ring road.
explanation_ru: Vans — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому для сравнения «меньше» требуется fewer, а не less.

prompt: Kavita checked the picnic basket before we locked the front door. Plenty of cold lemonade (is / are) left in the cool bag, so we do not need to stop at the garage. She also packed a (loaf / bread) and six ripe peaches for the beach. We reached the car park before the morning rush began.
explanation_ru: Lemonade — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому plenty of cold lemonade требует глагола is. Буханка хлеба передаётся через предлог of: a loaf of bread.

prompt: A large (number / amount) of hikers visit Snowdonia during the sunny summer months.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым существительным во множественном числе (hikers) употребляется a large number of, а не amount.

prompt: Our new washing machine makes far (fewer / less) noise than the old one, so the baby sleeps straight through.
explanation_ru: Noise в значении «шум» — неисчисляемое существительное, поэтому с ним используется less, а не fewer.

prompt: Once the charity relay in Swansea finished, each of the winning runners were handed a certificate and a metal bottle.
answer: Once the charity relay in Swansea finished, each of the winning runners was handed a certificate and a metal bottle.
accepted_answers: Once the charity relay in Swansea finished, each of the winning runners was handed a certificate and a metal bottle.
explanation_ru: Конструкция each of + существительное во множественном числе требует глагола в единственном числе (was handed). Ошибка возникает из-за влияния слова runners перед глаголом.

prompt: Heavy spring rain filled the garden tank with a huge ___ of rainwater that lasted through July.
explanation_ru: С неисчисляемым существительным rainwater сочетается a huge amount of. Ошибка — ставить number, many или several с неисчисляемыми.

prompt: Are there only a (few / little) spare helmets left inside the bike shed?
explanation_ru: Helmets — исчисляемое существительное во множественном числе, поэтому в выражении «всего несколько» выбираем a few.

prompt: (Every / All) swimmer must sign the pool register before jumping into the lane.
explanation_ru: Перед исчисляемым существительным в единственном числе (swimmer) используется Every; слово All требует множественного числа (All swimmers).

prompt: "Piotr, is there (some / any) oat milk left for my porridge?" "I'm afraid there is (no / none) milk at all in the fridge door. I poured the last drop into my coffee ten minutes ago. Could you grab a fresh (carton / milk) when you walk past the corner shop?"
explanation_ru: В обычном вопросе о наличии ставится any, перед существительным milk нужно no (а не none), а упаковка молока выражается через carton of milk.

prompt: The landlord handed Chidi two silver keys outside the flat in Derby, yet ___ of them turned the stiff front lock.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о двух ключах, и ни один не подошёл, поэтому нужно neither of them. Частые ошибки — ставить none (для трёх и более) или no of.

prompt: Lucia works as a volunteer at two sports clubs in Brighton, so she always has someone to invite for dinner or a walk.
options: Lucia has plenty of friends in Brighton, so she is rarely on her own.
Lucia has few friends in Brighton, so she is rarely on her own.
Lucia has much friends in Brighton, so she is rarely on her own.
Lucia has a little friends in Brighton, so she is rarely on her own.
explanation_ru: По смыслу у неё много друзей, поэтому верно plenty of friends; few означает «почти нет», а much и a little не употребляются с исчисляемым friends.

prompt: Wei invited me to a photography exhibition in an old Oxford warehouse. There were so (many / much) visitors crowded near the entrance that I barely recognised anyone from our college. I picked up a (glass / juice) from the back table and looked at the mountain landscapes instead. Luckily, Wei soon spotted me and introduced me to (both / either) of the photographers.
explanation_ru: С исчисляемым visitors используется so many, напиток в стакане обозначается как a glass of juice, а в утверждении о двух людях вместе требуется both of the photographers.

prompt: Samir usually adds two (spoonful / sugar) to his afternoon coffee, even though his dentist told him to cut down.
explanation_ru: С числительным two слово-мера spoonful получает множественное число и соединяется с неисчисляемым sugar предлогом of: two spoonfuls of sugar.

prompt: Have we still got (enough / plenty) pasta in the cupboard for six guests?
explanation_ru: Перед существительным без предлога of употребляется enough; вариант plenty требует предлога of (plenty of pasta).

prompt: Declan looked out of the tent at sunrise and smiled. There were (no / none) dark clouds over the valley, and the grass was already dry. We spent the (whole / all) afternoon walking along the river path without raincoats. Even the cold wind from the coast had completely disappeared.
explanation_ru: Перед существительным dark clouds ставится no, а не none. После определённого артикля the используется whole (the whole afternoon), а не all.

prompt: Farah went to the post office at eight in the morning expecting a queue. Instead, she saw almost nobody inside and posted her parcel in under two minutes.
options: There were a few customers in the post office, so Farah had a long wait.
There were little customers in the post office, so Farah posted her parcel quickly.
There were few customers in the post office, so Farah posted her parcel straight away.
There were much customers in the post office, so Farah left without posting it.
explanation_ru: Внутри почти никого не было, поэтому для исчисляемого customers нужно few («мало, почти нет»); a few противоречит смыслу, а little и much с исчисляемыми не употребляются.

prompt: "Sorry to bother you, could I have ___ more hot water, please?"
explanation_ru: В вежливых просьбах с Could I have употребляется some, а не any. Частая ошибка — выбирать any только из-за вопросительного знака.

prompt: Mateo asked me to read his history essay before the Friday deadline. I spotted (several / every) spelling mistakes in the first two paragraphs, along with two missing dates. Still, he appreciated my honest (piece / advice) about shortening the final section. By dinner, he had checked (each / both) paragraph carefully and printed a clean copy.
explanation_ru: С существительным во множественном числе mistakes ставится several, а не every. Неисчисляемое advice сочетается с piece of, а перед единственным числом paragraph подходит each, а не both.

prompt: My twin cousins have plenty of free time during the autumn holidays.
answer: My twin cousins have plenty of free time during the autumn holidays.
accepted_answers: My twin cousins have plenty of free time during the autumn holidays.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: plenty of свободно сочетается с неисчисляемым free time без артикля и без множественного числа.

prompt: Hanna has already finished (some / any) of the crime novels on the top shelf, though she hasn't touched the (other / others) yet.
explanation_ru: В утвердительной части предложения используется some of, а для замены существительного («остальные романы») без повторения слова novels нужна форма the others.

prompt: Dev couldn't find his train pass ten minutes before his morning commute to Dundee. He searched the (whole / most) flat from the hallway coat hooks to the bathroom shelf, getting more anxious by the second. Then he checked the two pockets of his rain jacket, yet (neither / either) of them held anything except old receipts. His flatmate finally spotted the blue card sitting on top of the kettle.
explanation_ru: После артикля the перед исчисляемым flat в значении «вся квартира целиком» ставится whole. При утвердительном глаголе held для значения «ни один из двух карманов» требуется neither.

prompt: Amina tested all three chargers in the office drawer, yet ___ of them supplied enough power to switch on her tablet.
explanation_ru: Зарядных устройств три, поэтому для значения «ни одно из них» выбираем none of them. Частые ошибки — ставить neither (только для двух) или no/every перед of.

prompt: Rhys found no fresh butter in the fridge for our weekend baking. → Rhys didn't find …
answer: Rhys didn't find any fresh butter in the fridge for our weekend baking.
accepted_answers: Rhys didn't find any fresh butter in the fridge for our weekend baking.
Rhys did not find any fresh butter in the fridge for our weekend baking.
explanation_ru: В английском предложении допускается только одно отрицание, поэтому при замене found no на отрицательный глагол didn't find слово no меняется на any.
